definitions.explanation: Something that has been decided or set in advance by rules, regulations, or agreement. Used as a modifier before nouns to indicate that something follows an established standard.

examples.japanese: {所定|しょてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in the designated form.

examples.japanese: {所定|しょてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませて→済む：01950_sumu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please complete the required procedures before entering.

examples.japanese: {所定|しょてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}しなければ→駐車する：22431_chuushasuru⟧、⟦{罰金|ばっきん}→罰金：18767_bakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}られる→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: If you don't park your car in the designated spot, you'll be fined.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used as a modifier before a noun ({所定|しょてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun). Very common in formal and administrative language — forms, procedures, official documents, and regulations. Rarely used in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {所定|しょてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧: prescribed/designated form
- {所定|しょてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: required procedures
- {所定|しょてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧: designated position/location
- {所定|しょてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: designated time
- {所定|しょてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧: prescribed amount
